name: CSS Grid Generator
description: Visually build responsive CSS Grid layouts using W3C CSS Grid Layout specifications with clean, production-ready output for U.S. frontend developers.
longDescription: CSS Grid Generator makes complex grid layouts intuitive for developers, students, and designers across the United States. Visually define rows and columns by dragging in the canvas. Set gap, alignment, and track sizing (fr, px, %, auto, minmax). Output follows W3C CSS Grid Layout Module Level 2 specifications for clean, production-ready code. See real-time preview with placeholder content. Copy clean CSS with fallbacks. Supports nested grids and named areas.
pricingDetails: Completely free and open source — $0 cost versus $12–$29/month paid layout builders. No account needed.
features: Visual drag-and-drop grid builder following W3C CSS Grid Layout specs
Track sizing (fr, px, %, auto, minmax) with clean code output
Gap, alignment, and named grid area controls
Real-time preview for responsive U.S. web layouts
Nested grids and production-ready CSS with fallbacks
Works instantly in Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge, and Brave
useCases: U.S. dashboard and article layouts built with standard CSS Grid
Photo galleries and responsive page structures for American audiences
Form layouts and design systems following W3C Grid specifications
Frontend teaching and rapid prototyping for students and developers
